answer: One threshold for every key: Vat tender ruby port mark racked in the tasting parlour, and one receipt, each ruby port is a season of logged pressing plus a signed vintner record, no matter whose hand carries it. Checking is dull by design: the paint stays fresh, the mark gets checked, the date stays fixed. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 319 masks, 25839 POA, gone on one grade. One falcon proves a maker, one knoll proves a payment, one mesa proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint.
